articles.title: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems
articles.summary: OpenAI is partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities, test connections with third-party services, and strengthen defenses with frontier AI.

articles.title: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science
articles.summary: OpenAI introduces BioBasicsBench, a 100-task benchmark measuring how well AI agents interpret raw experimental data and handle everyday wet-lab science.

articles.title: Cult.fit builds operational muscle with Codex
articles.summary: Cult.fit is using Codex to help teams across functions build tools, move faster, and change how work gets done.

articles.title: Australian universities are creating AI-native graduates
articles.summary: Australian universities are expanding access to ChatGPT and bringing AI into teaching and learning to prepare students for an AI-enabled workforce.

articles.title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
articles.summary: Introducing GPT‑6 Cyber, OpenAI’s cybersecurity model for finding exploitable vulnerabilities and developing fixes, trained to stay within authorized scope.

articles.title: Merge builds product and business tools with OpenAI technology
articles.summary: Merge uses GPT-6 Astra, ChatGPT, and Codex to review product code and support marketing. Its teams also use AI to plan executive dinners and prepare sales updates.
